avis.titre: Of Course This Works Differently For Every Woman
avis.texte: I'm reading the reviews here where women had no results or burning results. I have to mark that up to the fact that every single person will have a unique reaction to a 10% glycolic acid solution. It's just chemistry. For ME, these pads are amazing. For my best friend, too, who'd been using them when I noticed her complexion looked smooth and creamy. She turned me onto these Bliss pads and they work for me as well. My skin tone just looks creamier. I always follow with moisturizer and I do notice peeling so I use gentle milk cleansers and good moisturizers that DON'T have acids in them. I think that's key for me — I take an ebb and flow approach. I wouldn't use these "every night for a month and a half" like one woman here claimed, but space these out to maybe twice a week — giving my skin time to react and heal. (I wouldn't think it would be too smart to put 10% glycolic acid on any skin every night!) I've been using this at age 59 and 60 and my skin has responded well. Everyone is different.

avis.titre: The only product I actually remember to use routinely, it awesome!!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love these. I bought some a long time ago at a clearance store and fell in love. They are priced so reasonably. They seem to do everything I they claim and I use them 2 to 5 times a week. There is so much product on the pads that I can use it and seal the foil packet up and use it again and sometimes three times. They leave my skin soft, super exfoliated and I think my skin tone is a bit better. I usually struggle to use products routinely, except this one because of I don't use it my skin feels icky. I always recommend this to product. I am older and never use/used products until recently and don't use other products routinely so I'm a little shocked about ME being able to see/feel a difference with using it.

These have made a really huge difference in my pregnancy acne! I had acne as a teenager, but have always had very clear skin as an adult, so was baffled by what to do when acne cropped up in my second trimester. It seemed like my skin felt thicker—like the dead cells weren’t removing themselves fast enough—but any sort of scrub or manual exfoliation just irritated my skin. I started using these two nights a week, then upped it to three nights a week after a month. I did notice an increase in acne after the first week, but I read that glycolic acid can bring existing acne to the surface—sort of a “purging action,” I guess. So, I stuck with it, and I’m so glad I did. While I still have some tiny bumps, my skin is MUCH clearer and more glowy. No more big, painful, stuck-under-the-skin spots. At first, I wished the pads were a bit smaller, as the size/amount of product is really too much for just your face. Then I realized I could A) cut the pads in half, put half back in the foil packet, put the packet in a zipper baggie and save it (I wouldn’t recommend this if you’re skipping multiple days in between applications, since the pad does dry out a little), or B) apply it to my neck and chest as well, which is what I have been doing, and it’s really been smoothing out the skin there, too. Very glad I took a chance on these, as I’m not one to try many new skin care products!

I was about 26 years old when I first started noticing dullness in my skin. I still remember the relief I felt looking in the mirror the morning after I used one of these for the first time. I'm 35 now, and I keep these in my cabinet for an occasional quick reset that I know I can depend on. The pads mean easy clean up, and are large enough to swipe my face and neck before bed. The pads smell a little weird, but I don't mind since it only lasts a few seconds. I do feel some light stinging, which I don't mind, but I would caution others to limit these to weekly or bi-weekly use. Ultimately, these are a quick fix that I keep on hand for those nights where I'm too wiped for an intense skincare routine but need a little something extra. I always wake up looking brighter and more refreshed.

This product is perfect. I first bought it in a Bliss Spa and then I bought it on Amazon for a bit less. My last purchase was at Costco for significantly less but alas they don't carry it anymore online, so I will continue to purchase it here until they do. I have very mild acne scarring and this helps with that. I'm also in my early 40's and smooths out and refines my fine lines. It helps keep my skin clear and fresh. It just responds really well to this product yet it's so gentle. Men have thicker skin and most products are geared towards women so I'm glad this is effective but not harsh. I wash my face, tone and then put this on before serum and moisturizing. After my face and neck, I use what's left of the pad on my forearms which have mild sun damage from years of tennis and running. The premature age spots and crepey feel of my forearm skin has gone away. It may be the biggest benefit of this product. I was truly floored. I hate how expensive this is, but it's so effective that I won't stop. It's the most effective part of my skincare regimen.

I've been using this product for years, so obviously I like it. However, be aware that the description clearly says 5 pads/box. The boxes I received today (June 26, 2025) contain 4 pads each. New packaging, I guess.
Not sure that I've seen any difference. Probably won't be reordering.

avis.titre: Immediate results!! Very satisfied and will buy again!

All the online forums said it’s something I had to live with but this cleared it up after 2 uses. I’d definitely recommend getting this, honestly worth the money!!

avis.titre: Love these, my skin looks amazing
avis.texte: Love these, my skin looks amazing, be careful in sun though! make sure you wear an SPF if using them
My favorite glycolic pads! I have sensitive, acne prone skin and my skin loves these. I only use them once a week.

This is a extremely vulnerable review I am now age thirty and My skin officially is getting back at me for the years before Of sun expose, drinking , not hydrating, not sleeping enough and just life in general. I never NEVER leave without makeup so this is a first for me posted pictures With no makeup at all. This is about a month of using these pads one a week and I split them in half so I get a lot of use for the price. My skin is smoother, clearer and has more glow to it. I am forever grateful for this product. First 2 pictures are before , 3rd picture is after 2 uses, 4th is after 5 uses!

I love this product I have bad eczema and I get patches on the sides of my nose and that are flakey and painful after only three days of using this they are gone. My skin looks brighter and clearer. For the price you can’t go wrong

I prefer to use every other day but I definitely after two weeks of on and off use see a difference. I use the same pad twice bc to get more use out of them. So far I feel very happy with these and I am glad I took the chance on them! I use in conjunction with a microneedle, roller and vitamin c hydraulic serum.

So I was terrified to go for an actual peel at the spa and I saw some great reviews on this product. When I purchased it, I used to three times a week, wiped it over my dry skin, avoiding the eye area. After the second time, I noticed my sunspots starting to disappear, and my face having an amazing glow to it in the morning. This morning I was on a zoom call and someone actually mentioned how wonderful my skin looked. I will continue using this product.

Such a tiny square of fabric that’s it’s near impossible to get a hold of it and actually drag it across my face to get the product on. There’s plenty of product embedded but the sheet keeps falling off my face/out of my hands during application. Won’t be purchasing again.

Followed instructions and still ended up with a discoloration between my eyes on the day of a wedding. I only use the pads for a week at a time and only at night. Then I would give my skin a break for a few weeks and do it again for a week. I used to think this was a great product and I even recommended it to my friends. Now I’m not so sure this is safe. I hope the spot will fade. The picture was taken on day 3 of when it first appeared. I want to say be careful, but I was and it still happened.

The product is awesome! I have used it before, but!! This is the condition I received my most recent order in!! Looks as if it was ran over and repackaged in a zip lock bag! There are holes in the packets making it difficult to know if it’s still good. What am I to do?

avis.titre: Would do less than one star if I could
avis.texte: This is such a scam. I ordered what I thought were TWO packages of these (they come in a 15 pack box). I received 4 single wipes. For almost $43 I realized looking back at the description it does say 5. However I still should of received 10, and not just 4. Will be returning.

BE VERY CAREFUL! I bought these in hopes of helping my slightly appearing fine lines by my eyes, as well as the “frown lines”. I used ONE “treatment” and my skin is peeling, but what’s worse is the BURNING! ANYTHING I put on my face BURNS! Even my No7 Hydration Mask (cream). All of my washes, creams etc burn like fire! The kicker is, I do not have sensitive skin! I tolerate just about everything I’ve tried. Also, I have never written a review, so, that tells you just how much my skin is suffering! Lucky you if your skin doesn’t react the same way, but, you’ve been warned!
